description: Builds the annotated application against moirai.
instructions: Run integrate_apply (pass app_python when the app has its own Python) and integrate_validate; fix build failures through their arguments; report the flags used, the shim links and skipped names, and whether env_pythonpath, env_path_order, env_import, env_no_heavy_import and env_no_shadow passed. Report the unverified libstdc++ risk for moirai_smoke.
